title: 1526. Minimum Number of Increments on Subarrays to Form a Target Array

examples.explanation: We need at least 3 operations to form the target array from the initial array. [0,0,0,0,0] increment 1 from index 0 to 4 (inclusive). [1,1,1,1,1] increment 1 from index 1 to 3 (inclusive). [1,2,2,2,1] increment 1 at index 2. [1,2,3,2,1] target array is formed.
